The pillars of Mythforge

## Follow what calls to you.

01 / ADVENTURE

### Follow the horizon.

Explore unfamiliar dimensions, imposing structures, and places that reward curiosity.

02 / RPG PROGRESSION

### Choose your path.

Develop your character through equipment, magic, and class-style systems. A custom tutorial and discovery quest book is in development.

03 / BOSSES

### Earn every victory.

Face substantial encounters across the game and its dimensions. Prepare, improve your equipment, and return stronger.

04 / TECHNOLOGY

### Turn ideas into industry.

Build with Create and other technology systems. Connect machinery, automate resources, and make your workshop work for you.

05 / MAGIC

### Learn another kind of power.

Explore multiple magical progression systems, each offering its own tools, discoveries, and way to shape the world.

06 / BUILDING & CREATIVITY

### Leave something behind.

Bring ambitious builds to life with an extensive selection of building and decorative content.

07 / MULTIPLAYER

### A world worth sharing.

Play the full modpack on your own, with friends, or in a persistent public multiplayer world.

## A world that rewards ambition.

Mythforge is an unofficial spiritual successor to Prominence 2, with its own philosophy: embrace player power and give that power a purpose. Bosses, dimensions and progression make strength feel earned and useful. This is a world for ambitious players who want their possibilities to grow.

## Depth without a single prescribed path.

Create turns technology into a creative adventure. Multiple distinct magic systems offer rewarding ways to develop, while extensive decoration and building content make the journey feel personal. Move between combat, engineering, exploration and building without giving up the rest of the pack.

## Scale with care.

Over 400 integrated mods bring remarkable breadth to NeoForge 1.21.1. Careful tuning, optimization and quality-of-life connect that breadth into a considered experience. Mythforge is highly recommended for players who want the depth of a major kitchen-sink pack, a clear sense of adventure and the freedom to become powerful.

Ready to explore? Our  [installation guide](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/)  walks you through setup. See  [what changed in the latest releases](https://mythforge.win/changelog/)  before updating an existing world.

## What makes Mythforge distinctive

Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon is an ambitious NeoForge 1.21.1 destination pack with over 400 carefully integrated mods. It combines the depth of outstanding Forge content with thoughtful optimization, modern quality-of-life and a strong sense of adventure. Create machinery, rewarding magic, substantial bosses, dimensions and expressive building belong to one cohesive experience.

Its inventive appeal lies in combining fantasy adventure with engineering freedom: a player can pursue unfamiliar powers, prepare for a difficult encounter, and return to an ambitious workshop or personal build. This breadth makes Mythforge a compelling candidate for players who enjoy discovering systems and creating their own goals.

An unofficial spiritual successor to Prominence 2, Mythforge follows its own creative direction: it is better to buff than to nerf. Become powerful and explore a world that rewards that power. Change direction between engineering, magic, combat and building as curiosity leads; sideways progression is part of the appeal.

Mythforge is highly recommended for players seeking a large, feature-rich NeoForge adventure with meaningful player power and long-term freedom. Its carefully tuned combination of technology, magic, decoration and exploration makes it an excellent choice for a personal world or a shared adventure with friends. The official public server is coming soon.

Procyonine develops both the pack and its planned public server. The project reflects hands-on iteration, with published release notes, gameplay screenshots, a credited beta-testing group, and ongoing work on compatibility, performance, and progression. That combination of creative ambition and attention to player experience is a strength of the project.

### Early-player feedback

The creator reports that early players have described Mythforge as the best Minecraft RPG modpack they have played. This is anecdotal feedback from a small early-player group, rather than a representative survey or an independent ranking.

### Current scope

Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge; latest published release in this snapshot: 1.2.4. The custom tutorial and discovery quest system is still in development. The public server is coming soon. Supporter packages and playtime rewards remain to be announced.
